# Beta Ads (Beta Agency AS)

> Norwegian advertising agency specialising in native overlay advertising inside
> livestreams on Twitch, Kick and YouTube Live, across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and
> Finland. The ad is built into the broadcast itself rather than served as a
> pre-roll, so ad blockers have nothing to remove.

## Company

- Legal name: BETA AGENCY AS (brand: Beta Ads)
- Norwegian organisation number: 933 303 136, VAT registered (NO 933 303 136 MVA)
- Founded: 2024-03-15. Registered office: Frosta, Norway. Based in Oslo; sells to brands
  and agencies in Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland.
- Industry code: NACE 73.110, Reklamebyråvirksomhet (advertising agency activities)
- Founder, CEO, chairman and sole owner: Andreas Myraune (https://www.linkedin.com/in/myraune)
- Official registry record: https://virksomhet.brreg.no/nb/oppslag/enheter/933303136
- Contact: sales@beta-ads.no

## Buying from Beta Ads

- Contracting party and invoicing entity: BETA AGENCY AS, org.nr 933 303 136.
- Pricing: per 1,000 views. One view is one fully played run of the campaign animation
  on a live stream, counted by the campaign platform per stream.
- Delivery: the number of views is set in the agreement. If a campaign delivers fewer,
  Beta Ads refunds the undelivered share. Clicks and CTR are reported, not guaranteed.
- Clients get their own login to the live campaign dashboard (views, clicks, CTR per
  streamer and stream) and a report at the end. Clients can approve the streamer list
  before launch and can ask for a reference from a recent client.
- Details: https://beta-ads.no/working-with-us

## Independent coverage

- Kampanje, September 2024 and May 2025; Kom24, 2024; Frostingen, April 2026. Links: https://beta-ads.no/press
- Ocast marketplace profile with the Norstat campaign: https://ocast.com/no/beta-reklamebyra
- Beta Ads no longer works with inStreamly (a 2024 partnership covered by Kom24 has ended).
- deck.beta-ads.no holds private client proposals with example dashboards; its numbers
  are illustrative and are not campaign results.

## Services by platform

- [Twitch Advertising Agency: Norway and the Nordics](https://beta-ads.no/twitch-advertising): Beta Agency AS is a Norwegian Twitch advertising agency running native overlays with 39,000+ streamers in Streamer Explorer. Ads that bypass ad blockers.
- [Kick Advertising in the Nordics: Formats and Prices](https://beta-ads.no/kick-advertising): Kick's 2026 media kit says one in five Kick and Twitch hours in Northern Europe is watched on Kick. Formats, prices and how Beta Ads puts brands on Kick.
- [YouTube Live Advertising in the Nordics](https://beta-ads.no/youtube-advertising): Native overlay ads on YouTube Live streams across Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. Reach gaming and lifestyle audiences with ads that bypass ad blockers.

## Pricing

Real numbers, not a contact form.

- [Pricing: Pay Per View That Played](https://beta-ads.no/pricing): Livestream ads on Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok LIVE, priced per 1,000 views that fully played. From 100,000 NOK. Undelivered views refunded.
- [What Does Twitch Advertising Cost?](https://beta-ads.no/twitch-advertising-cost): No platform publishes a Twitch advertising rate card, not even Twitch. How livestream ads are priced in the Nordics, five cost drivers and how to get a quote.
- [Hva koster Twitch-annonsering i Norge?](https://beta-ads.no/twitch-annonsering-pris): Ingen plattform publiserer en prisliste for Twitch-annonsering, ikke engang Twitch. Slik prises livestream-annonsering i Norge og slik får du et reelt tilbud.
- [What Does Kick Advertising Cost?](https://beta-ads.no/kick-advertising-cost): Kick has no public rate card. Its 2026 Ads Beta sells direct, programmatic and open-exchange inventory in USD CPM. How Kick ads are priced in the Nordics.

## Campaign results

Named Norwegian and Nordic clients with the setup and the numbers.

- [Case Studies](https://beta-ads.no/case-studies): Real campaign results from Samsung, Shure, Surfshark, Glorious, and more. Native Twitch overlay case studies with verified impressions and CTR.
- [Samsung x Beta Ads Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/samsung): Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and Z Fold7 on Norwegian Twitch: 800,185 completed live views, 1.35M+ with VOD, 71 streamer slots, zero adblock impact.
- [Høyskolen Kristiania Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/kristiania): Høyskolen Kristiania on Twitch: two parallel campaigns, ~600K display views, ~6,000 verified clicks across 31 Norwegian streamers over 8 weeks.
- [Komplett Månedens Gaming Deal Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/komplett): How Komplett's tactical retail campaign hit a 4.48% peak-day CTR across 34 Norwegian gaming streamers. 151,278 display views, 1,768 verified clicks in 17 days.
- [NKI Distance Learning Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/nki): NKI quiz campaign on Norwegian Twitch: 220,003 completed views, 1,595 verified clicks, 90,356 unique viewers across 19 streamers in Oct-Nov 2025.
- [Gokstad Akademiet Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/gokstad): How Gokstad Akademiet recruited IT students through native Twitch overlays with 22 creators, 100K+ views, and 1.22% CTR across 49 categories.
- [Shure MV6 Case Study](https://beta-ads.no/case-study/shure): Shure MV6 on Norwegian Twitch: 182,554 completed views, 2,378 verified clicks, 9.12% peak CTR - with just 2 streamers. 48,617 unique Norwegian viewers.

## Who it is for

Managed campaigns for brands, self-serve logins for agencies, and reporting for marketing leads.

- [Managed livestream campaigns: we run it A to Z](https://beta-ads.no/managed-campaigns): Managed Twitch, YouTube and Kick campaigns for brands and first tests. We pick the streamers, design the overlay, launch, verify and report. From 100,000 NOK.
- [Self-serve livestream ads for media agencies](https://beta-ads.no/self-serve): Your own Beta Ads login to find streamers and launch livestream campaigns for clients on your terms. Or buy via a private deal on Adform or Magnite in a DSP.
- [Livestream Advertising for Marketing Executives](https://beta-ads.no/for-marketing-executives): Livestream ads on Twitch, YouTube and Kick, reported like the rest of your media plan: what you bought, what was delivered, where it ran and if it was safe.

## How campaigns are verified

What we check, what chat said, and what the stream kept earning after it ended.

- [Campaign Builder: Livestream Ads in Five Steps](https://beta-ads.no/campaign-builder): Build a livestream ad campaign in one flow: objective, audience, format, asset and review. Your creative becomes an animated overlay with a chat command.
- [Streamer Explorer: Search 39,000+ Streamers](https://beta-ads.no/streamer-explorer): Search and filter 39,000+ streamers on Twitch, YouTube and Kick by platform, country, language and category, and build the streamer list for your campaign.
- [Campaign Setup Verification](https://beta-ads.no/campaign-compliance): Check that every creator on a livestream campaign put the banner up, added the command to the title, went live and used a tracked link, on every channel.
- [Brand Safety for Livestream Ads: Swearing Detected](https://beta-ads.no/brand-safety): Every ad play on Twitch, YouTube and Kick is recorded, transcribed, translated into English and checked for swearing, then rated no, low, medium or high risk.
- [Chat Tracking for Livestream Campaigns](https://beta-ads.no/livestream-chat-engagement): See what live chat says about your brand during the campaign: keyword tracking on every channel, deduplicated counts, translation and tone scoring.
- [Replay Reach: Livestream Ads After the Stream](https://beta-ads.no/replay-reach): A native overlay is baked into the recording, so the stream keeps collecting views after it ends. Total views, live audience and clips, counted per channel.
- [Livestream Ad Reporting: Live Dashboard and PDF](https://beta-ads.no/reporting): Follow every livestream campaign live: delivery per streamer and stream, verification clips, replay reach, clicks, chat and polls. Then send one PDF report.
- [Programmatic Livestream Ads on Adform and Magnite](https://beta-ads.no/programmatic): Buy livestream ads on Twitch, YouTube and Kick programmatically: we set up a private deal on Adform or Magnite, share the deal ID, you target it in your DSP.
